paragraphs.text: That is, one that has been a harlot for a long time: not that the Prophet did this thing in effect, but he saw this in a vision, or else was commanded by God to set forth under this parable or figure the idolatry of the Synagogue, and of the people her children.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: of whoredoms and children of whoredoms

paragraphs.text: Gomer signifies a consumption or corruption, and rotten clusters of figs, declaring that they were all corrupt like rotten figs.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Meaning that they would no longer be called Israelites, which name they boasted because Israel did prevail with God: but that they were as bastards, and therefore should be called Jezreelites, that is, scattered people, alluding to Jezreel, which was the chief city of the ten tribes under Ahab, where Jehu shed so much blood; 1Ki 18:45.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: I will be avenged upon Jehu for the blood that he shed in Jezreel: for even though God stirred him up to execute his judgments, yet he did them for his own ambition, and not for the glory of God as the intended goal: for he built up that idolatry which he had destroyed.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: When the measure of their iniquity is full, and I will take vengeance and destroy all their administration and strength.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, not obtaining mercy: by which he signifies that God's favour had departed from them.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: For the Israelites never returned after they were taken captives by the Assyrians.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: For after their captivity he restored them miraculously by the means of Cyrus; Ezr 1:1.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: save them by the LORD their

paragraphs.text: Because they thought that God could not have been true in his promise unless he had preserved them, he declares that though they were destroyed, yet the true Israelites who are the sons of the promise, would be without number, who consist both of the Jews and the Gentiles; Ro 9:26.
paragraphs.label: m
paragraphs.anchor: children of Israel shall be as

paragraphs.text: That is, after the captivity of Babylon, when the Jews were restored: but chiefly this refers to the time of Christ, who would be the head both of the Jews and Gentiles.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: The calamity and destruction of Israel will be so great, that to restore them will be a miracle.
